[2026-10-22 00:24 CEST] Same-symbol edge comparison control is checked and pushed. Proof a1bc2fada4b8bc98ef524897b1b70a8c96d407df; checkpoint 20f4181948591157e502391e20698138b04b2221. SourceCurrentSameSymbolEdgeControl.miss_readback derives the actual direct empty-domain native edgeBody trace and exact returned pair cells from an observed successful comparison when BOTH ordered identity keys were initially absent. It retains the SAME full checked before/after, separate typed pair memo and every earlier returned cell. A strict reversal publishes a distinct reversed cell; both capture their original operand order and return the same result. This is completed-past provenance, not a producer of completion, semantics or warm-hit history.

Useful control distinction: memoWith publishes the original operand pair before demand and ordering. Descending operands can therefore publish TWO keys. Native domain-indexed edge caches are a separate table. Pre-sorting, replacing that pair memo, adding an equal-edge shortcut, resetting state or dropping discarded comparison effects would change the modeled control.

Selected strict3 passes at default declaration limits with an empty log. Sole FULL and Audit pass: 3624 jobs/75337 theorem dependencies. Complete check/print TYPEs match; root and independent reviews read all449 logical TYPE lines. All eight private helper names/four private markers are absent from TYPE; actual axioms are the standard three. The large proof body is retained/programmatically checked; no whole manual-body review is claimed. Five actual Lean/Lake jobs retain strict1 failure, strict2 warned zero, clean strict3, FULL and Audit. All drafts and exact repairs remain. Root corrected premature empty-log commentary on strict2.

Normal/live proof verification, preservation of75687 starting blobs/modes,291 frozen registries/1385 entries, all268 Haskell/207 package files, sealed1724 checksums/1735 entries, clean FS=index=HEAD for77414 tracked files and exact remote formalize/main readback pass. FINDINGS keeps the external Haskell repair index first. No new Haskell repair.

Strongest combined theorem remains ColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls: actual source construction and any chosen finite N partial calls through the same full returned states, with one mathematical width/fuel schedule and exact final finite-tree language under formalized guards/empty inherited constraints. Completion is derived, not assumed. Full withoutRedundantEdges, convergence, practical host bounds, external solver/table composition and Haskell refinement remain open.

Next reviewed semantic inventory shows how genuine ContextualCompletion.edge_complete receipts can supply result/full-state laws; readiness for a next ORIGINAL cluster pair follows from resident-edge growth and empty_domain. A NEW forward BOTH-miss completion plan outside H7 proposes invoking that producer once and lifting its actual trace, then using miss_readback. That plan has no theorem body or compiler check and still needs independent review. Genuine pair admission/Completes/WordRanges, sequence resources, warm pair writer history, ruleOut/cluster/Mu control and the public pass remain open. Restart: lean/notes-current-same-symbol-edge-control.md and lean/restart-evidence/20261021-same-symbol-edge-control/. Whole goal active.
